scripts.db:rls: prisma db execute --file prisma/sql/rls.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db execute --file prisma/sql/auth.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db execute --file prisma/sql/billing.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db execute --file prisma/sql/foods-lgpd.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db execute --file prisma/sql/patients.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db execute --file prisma/sql/agenda.sql --schema prisma/schema.prisma
